CREATE INDEX flowfn_jobs_claim_order ON flowfn_plan_e419e4ecbacb4b359f7f66409fca76a0.flowfn_jobs USING btree (queue, priority DESC, (
CASE
    WHEN COALESCE((((data -> 'opts'::text) ->> 'lifo'::text))::boolean, false) THEN 0
    ELSE 1
END), (
CASE
    WHEN COALESCE((((data -> 'opts'::text) ->> 'lifo'::text))::boolean, false) THEN enqueue_order
    ELSE NULL::bigint
END) DESC, enqueue_order) WHERE (state = ANY (ARRAY['waiting'::text, 'delayed'::text]))
actualClaimPlans.sql:
WITH ready_clock AS MATERIALIZED (
        SELECT floor(extract(epoch from clock_timestamp())*1000)::bigint AS now
      ), candidate AS MATERIALIZED (
        SELECT j.id FROM "flowfn_plan_e419e4ecbacb4b359f7f66409fca76a0"."flowfn_jobs" j CROSS JOIN ready_clock
        WHERE j.queue=$1 AND j.state IN ('waiting','delayed') AND j.available_at<=ready_clock.now
          
          AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM jsonb_array_elements_text(COALESCE(j.data->'opts'->'waitFor','[]'::jsonb)) dependency
            WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM "flowfn_plan_e419e4ecbacb4b359f7f66409fca76a0"."flowfn_jobs" d WHERE d.queue=j.queue AND d.id=dependency AND d.state='completed'))
        ORDER BY j.priority DESC, CASE WHEN COALESCE((j.data->'opts'->>'lifo')::boolean,false) THEN 0 ELSE 1 END ASC, CASE WHEN COALESCE((j.data->'opts'->>'lifo')::boolean,false) THEN j.enqueue_order END DESC, j.enqueue_order ASC
        FOR UPDATE OF j SKIP LOCKED LIMIT 1
      ), claim AS MATERIALIZED (
        SELECT candidate.id,floor(extract(epoch from clock_timestamp())*1000)::bigint AS now FROM candidate
      )
      UPDATE "flowfn_plan_e419e4ecbacb4b359f7f66409fca76a0"."flowfn_jobs" j SET state='active',data=j.data || jsonb_build_object('state','active','processedOn',claim.now,
        'lease',jsonb_build_object('token',$2::text,'expiresAt',claim.now+$3))
      FROM claim WHERE j.queue=$4 AND j.id=claim.id RETURNING j.data
